what_happened: Scene: layout/style 9 (white tiles, navy cabinets); knife (knife_7, wooden handle) in a drawer 1.39 m from the board, so the base had to move; board and plate with a fish (fish_7) side by side on the counter. Stage 0: first closes on the knife at 278 (width 0.043, no lift) and 298 (fingers shut to 0.002, slipped); re-grasped at 371 (lift from 381, 0.44 m), moved the base, and released the knife flat on the board at 577 (0.040 m from centre); stage 0 complete 575 (median 486). Stage 1: grasped the fish by its tail fin at 667 (lift from 678, 0.15 m) and carried it hanging head-down to the board. It released at 791 over the board's front-left corner (wrist 776-800: the hanging fish is at the lower-left corner of the board), 0.196 m from the board centre; the fish dropped 8 cm and came to rest diagonally with its head on the front-left edge of the board and its tail on the counter (left-view zoom 860). Stage 1 never held. The arm then rose straight up (900-1000), looked down at the board at 1040 and 1280 (fish visibly hanging off the corner), and from ~1360 reached over the now-empty plate and closed on air at 1451, then stayed low near the plate until 1600.
causal_chain: knife on board 575 (normal) -> fish grasped by the tail 667, carried hanging -> released at 791 over the board's front-left corner, 0.196 m from centre -> fish fell half off the board (centre 0.19 m from board centre, never at target) -> policy did not re-grasp the fish; it went back to the empty plate (close on air 1451) -> timeout
self_recovery: Stage 0: knife grasp slipped at 298, re-grasped successfully at 371. Stage 1: no attempt on the misplaced fish; the late close at 1451 was on air over the empty plate.
official_criterion_notes: Stage 0 shows two 1-step drops (860, 1075, 'an object left the target') right after the fish landed against the board; the knife visibly stays on the board, so these are boundary flickers, not undos.
